say:0:1611151001:0.text: The murmurs swell into a roar, everyone repeating the same words:
say:0:1611151001:0.source_cn: 周围的声音嘈杂起来，从窃窃私语到人声鼎沸。大家都在说着...

say:1:1611151002:0.source_cn: 梅林大人，梅林大人回来了！

say:3:1611151003:0.text: Merlin... That mark... It really is you...
say:3:1611151003:0.source_cn: 梅林……这个印记，你、你真的是梅林……
say:3:1611151003:0.male: Merlin... That mark... It really is you...
say:3:1611151003:0.female: Merlin... That mark... It really is you...

say:14:1611151012:0.text: Cassadee, congratulations. You've officially passed the Court Mage Selection Exam. The seat is yours. The formal appointment will follow once the palace has been notified.

say:15:1611151013:0.text: I do hope you're ready for the responsibility. As Chief Court Mage, I will be <style="highlight">watching</style> your career with great interest.
